visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black glasses and a Pikachu headband stands next to a large Pikachu mascot wearing a green jacket and a black hat. He gestures excitedly towards the camera. The background shows the Taipei 101 building under a clear blue sky. White text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing in front of a giant inflatable Pikachu. He points towards the camera while on-screen text shows specific event dates. A row of Pokéballs is visible on a stand behind him. (3) Quick montage shots of various night market game booths: a 'push the cup' game with a green zone, a basket with oranges, and multiple basketball hoops arranged in a grid. The lighting shifts to daytime outdoor event lighting. (4) The man is now in a night setting with red lanterns hung overhead. He points his thumb upwards, smiling widely. Glowing Pokémon figures like Chikorita and Umbreon are visible in the background. (5) The man interacts with various standees of 'Mega Evolution' Pokémon including Mega Pidgeot, Mega Dragonite, and Mega Charizard X and Y. He makes clawing gestures and poses dramatically. (6) The man sits under a white tent, holding a handheld controller while playing a Pokémon game on a large television screen. He reacts with surprise and joy as he catches a Buneary on screen. (7) Final shot returns to the man in front of the giant inflatable Pikachu at night, holding a promotional fan and gesturing for the audience to join the event. Text overlays summarize the location and time.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 台北這四天有皮卡丘見面會. (2) [Slogan]: 2025.10.16(四)~19(日) 台北101水舞廣場. (3) [Subtitle]: 杯子推到綠區 就闖關成功!. (4) [Subtitle]: 《寶可夢傳說 Z-A》夜市祭. (5) [Subtitle]: 一局有30秒 挑戰. (6) [Subtitle]: 白天很好玩 但夜市祭的晚上很漂亮!!. (7) [Subtitle]: 好像真的在逛一個祭典的感覺. (8) [Slogan]: 「超級進化」將會登場. (9) [Variety]: 卡卡 快問快答. (10) [Subtitle]: 既然是免費試玩 我現在要再來體驗一次. (11) [Variety]: 捕捉! 捲捲耳~. (12) [Slogan]: 等你來!!!

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator (HowHow), 1 female colleague (partially visible during interview), and approximately 6 passers-by in the background of the night market.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with black-rimmed glasses, wearing a light tan/beige t-shirt, light blue baggy pants, and a yellow Pikachu-themed headband visor.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video takes place at the Taipei 101 Water Dance Square. It features the iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper, temporary event tents, various Pokémon-themed game booths, inflatable structures, and night market decorations like red lanterns and string lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins with a fast speech rate and high pitch variability. Background music is a high-tempo, major-mode electronic track reminiscent of Pokémon battle themes. (2) A sharp digital 'UI click' SFX triggers a transition. The speaker's volume increases as he emphasizes the event dates. (3) Environmental noise shifts as the speaker moves outdoors; distant laughter and a light urban hum are audible. (4) A short 'ping' sound effect marks a new phase where a female voice briefly answers a question with high clarity. (5) In-game sound effects, specifically a rhythmic 'thud' and a sparkling 'catch success' SFX, dominate the mix for 3 seconds while the speaker laughs. (6) The vocal energy peaks in the final phase with a rising intonation pattern as the speaker delivers the call to action, accompanied by a swelling synth stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience -> Feature Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional advertisement for the 'Pokémon Legends: Z-A' Night Market event in Taipei. It aims to build excitement by showcasing interactive games, night market aesthetics, and a free trial of the upcoming game to encourage attendance during the specified dates.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly addresses the camera to promote the specific dates, location, and activities of a Pokémon-themed event, including game trials and mascot appearances.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The creator's persona (HowHow) is deeply integrated with the Pokémon brand, using themed accessories and in-depth knowledge to target fans.
